text: This is my home page! To read my tutorial blog about neural networks, go to the Tutorial Blog tab.

title: A Beginner’s Guide to Understanding Neural Networks
text: In our day and age, Artifial Intelligence (AI) is proving to be a more and more powerful tool. Due to its power, some people can see the things it does and think that it is utterly inscrutable. However, I want to push back against that idea by teaching you about neural networks! Neural networks are the foundation of deep learning, which in turn means that an understanding of neural networks can teach us more about how AI works! In this blog, I aim to teach you the fundamentals of the basic structure of neural networks, explain how neural networks are trained, and give an example of neural networks in action.
